answer_text:
Here are some great places where you can order a birthday cake online:

---

### 🎂 1. **Bake Me A Wish** — [bakemeawish.com](https://www.bakemeawish.com)
Bake Me A Wish began in 2005 as a premier nationwide service for gourmet birthday cake delivery, with cakes made using only the finest, freshest ingredients by award-winning New York bakeries. They offer a wide range of flavors beyond traditional vanilla and chocolate, including Tiramisu, Salted Caramel, Tres Leches, Limoncello, Boston Cream, and Coconut Cream.

---

### 🎂 2. **Milk Bar** — [milkbarstore.com](https://milkbarstore.com)
Milk Bar is best known for its playful and innovative approach to classic desserts. Their cakes have a distinctive naked frosting style with no outer frosting layer on the sides to showcase the layers of cake and filling, and are typically topped with cake truffles. Their iconic Birthday Cake is a funfetti-inspired vanilla cake layered with frosting and rainbow sprinkles.

---

### 🎂 3. **Goldbelly** — [goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com)
Goldbelly curates standout cakes from America's most famous bakeries, featuring favorites like chocolate cakes, red velvet cakes, birthday cakes, cookie cakes, bundt cakes, and more. Top bakers, including Carousel Cakes, Daisy Cakes, and We Take the Cake, ship cakes nationwide on Goldbelly, including gluten-free, kosher, nut-free, and Paleo options.

---

### 🎂 4. **Harry & David** — [harryanddavid.com](https://www.harryanddavid.com)
Their gourmet cakes, specialty desserts, and cheesecakes are handcrafted in their Southern Oregon bakery and delivered nationwide. You can choose from rich chocolate birthday cakes, classic vanilla, and seasonal favorites, all made with premium ingredients for fresh, bakery-quality flavor.

---

### 🎂 5. **Magnolia Bakery** — [magnoliabakery.com](https://www.magnoliabakery.com)
If you want a good old-fashioned birthday cake, Magnolia is a great option — they take simple, classic flavors like vanilla, chocolate, and carrot cake and make them phenomenal with high-quality ingredients.

---

### 🎂 6. **Whole Foods Market** — [wholefoodsmarket.com](https://www.wholefoodsmarket.com)
Many Whole Foods Market locations offer a selection of cakes that can be ordered ahead online for easy pickup in store. From their cult-favorite Berry Chantilly Cake to the decadent Chocolate Eruption Cake, their Bakery options can make any event memorable.

---

### 🎂 7. **Publix Bakery** — [publix.com](https://www.publix.com)
Publix hand-decorates custom cakes in-store to suit your occasion, and you can choose from a wide selection of themes featuring favorite sports, TV shows, and movies, or customize a cake with your choice of flavor, filling, and icing. Order at least 24 hours before your event, and they'll have it ready for you.

---

Whether you want nationwide shipping or local pickup, there's a great option for every taste and budget! 🎉
